claims.text: The hotel occupies the 79th to the 93rd floors of the Shanghai World Financial Centre.

findings.quote: Spanning the 79th to the 93rd floors of the Shanghai World Financial Centre (SWFC)
Asia's second most vertiginous hotel is on floors 79 through 93 of the Shanghai World Financial Center

claims.text: The hotel is in the heart of the Lujiazui business district.

findings.quote: Park Hyatt Shanghai's prime location in the heart of the Lujiazui business district

claims.text: The hotel is a 5-minute walk from Exit 6 of Lujiazui Metro Station.

findings.quote: Park Hyatt Shanghai is located a 5-minute walk from Exit 6 of Lujiazui Station.

claims.text: Every room has views of either the Huangpu River or the Shanghai cityscape.

findings.quote: Every room features views of either the Huangpu River or the Shanghai cityscape.

claims.text: Rooms have a separate powder room with a Washlet and a bathroom with a walk-in rain shower and deep soaking tub.

findings.quote: a separate powder room for privacy with a Washlet, and a deluxe bathroom with a walk-in rain shower and deep soaking tub.

claims.text: An infinity pool and heated hot tub are on level 85.

findings.quote: Water’s Edge signature infinity pool and heated hot tub on level 85

claims.text: The spa offers treatments focused on health, wellbeing and harmonious balance.

findings.quote: Water’s Edge Spa provides a selection of treatments that focus on the concept of health, wellbeing and harmonious balance.

claims.text: Dining Room on level 87 is a contemporary Chinese restaurant serving modern Shanghainese, Zhejiang and Jiangsu cuisines.

findings.quote: Located on Level 87, Dining Room is a contemporary Chinese restaurant that celebrates modern Shanghainese, Zhejiang and Jiangsu cuisines

claims.text: 100 Century Avenue Steakhouse serves a grill menu of prime beef, market-fresh seafood and premium poultry.

findings.quote: presenting a grill menu that features a wide selection of prime beef, market-fresh seafood, and premium poultry.
findings.note: stated in 100 Century Avenue Steakhouse entry

claims.text: 100 Century Avenue Cantonese serves traditional dim sum on the east side of level 91.

findings.quote: 100 Century Avenue Cantonese brings you traditional dim sum, steamed and authentic hot dishes on the east side of Level 91.

claims.text: 100 Century Avenue Bar is on level 91.

findings.quote: Located on level 91, 100 Century Avenue Bar offers guests a comfortable, intimate setting for casual drinks.

claims.text: The Living Room on level 87 is a residential-style venue that encloses the reception area.

findings.quote: Living Room is a residential-style venue located on level 87, enclosing the reception area.

claims.text: Dining Room was named a Selected Restaurant in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Shanghai and received One Diamond in the 2026 Black Pearl Restaurant Guide.

findings.quote: Dining Room has been awarded the 2026 Black Pearl Restaurant Guide – One Diamond and the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Shanghai "Selected Restaurant.".

claims.text: The art includes hundreds of ceramics by Liu Jianhua hanging from the ceiling of 100 Century Avenue.

findings.quote: hundreds of kitsch ceramics by Liu Jianhua hanging from the ceiling of 100 Century Avenue

claims.text: The hotel was designed by New York-based designer Tony Chi as a modern-Chinese residence.

findings.quote: Designed by award-winning New York-based designer Tony Chi, Park Hyatt Shanghai was conceived as a sophisticated modern-Chinese residence.

claims.text: In-house guests can join a complimentary Morning Sound Bowl Floating Experience at Water's Edge on level 85 on Thursdays and Sundays, with reservations required.

findings.quote: a complimentary Morning Sound Bowl Floating Experience from 6:30–7:30 a.m. every Thursday and Sunday at Water's Edge on level 85, exclusively for in-house guests. Reservations are required.

claims.text: Park Salon on level 86 is open exclusively to in-house guests and offers free-flow champagne and premium wines.

findings.quote: Perched on Level 86, Park Salon is a perfect space for business engagements and leisurely staycations. Open exclusively for in-house guests
intimate space features all-day champagne and premium wines free-flow

claims.text: Hotel parking spaces are limited and reserved for in-house guests.

findings.quote: Park Hyatt Shanghai offers limited parking spaces exclusively for in-house guests, on the hotel’s ground floor driveway.

claims.text: The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.

findings.quote: we recommend using local mapping applications such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map. International mapping apps may not be accurate in Chinese Mainland.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the modern skyscraper setting may lack traditional Shanghai charm.
